title: Ourang Medan 1940: The Crew Found Staring at the Sky
description:
A ship sends an SOS that ends with the words I die, and the story says every sailor aboard was found dead, staring at the sky. This case file traces the Ourang Medan ghost ship legend from its first appearance in 1940 to the later versions.

We look at the distress call, the boarding, the fire, the survivor who may never have existed, the poison gas and carbon monoxide theories, and why no record of the ship has ever been found.

Do you think the Ourang Medan was real, or a story told too well? Tell us in the comments.
